This 22 m² apartment is situated 3.5 km from Ha Noi train station and in close proximity to Vien Cong nghe Xa hiem bus station. The apartment lies in the Dong Da district, around a 15-minute ride from the historic Buddhist temple "One Pillar Pagoda". Take a peaceful 30 minutes' stroll into the heart of Hanoi city centre. Nam Mi Homestay provides guests with a balcony, as well as such modern comforts as an air conditioner. The property features a bathroom with hairdryers and bath sheets. Furthermore, a bidet and a separate toilet is available.
